mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over a 3-month period indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals weakening economic conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over a 6-month period indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST increases > 5% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 1% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.5% in 3 months, it indicates a tightening monetary policy with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening demand with labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS decreases > 2% and UNRATE increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 6-month period indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 1% over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) combined with a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests a shift towards service-oriented growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and INDPRO decreases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met.
